rendered_documents.body:
### Beginner Candidate Framework

- Generated at: 2026-05-10T06:45:53.568397+00:00
- Version: v1
- Audience: beginner quant trader

### What this note is trying to do
- Explain the key ideas in plain language.
- Tell you what to do first, what to avoid for now, and what must be verified before upgrading stages.
- Keep research, execution advice and risk prompts separate.

### Learning order
- Understand core concepts and risk language before touching execution settings.
- Learn the research workflow: hypothesis -> data check -> backtest -> simulation -> review.
- Study a small candidate set and explain why each name is on the list.
- Write a risk budget and pause rules before any simulation session.
- Notice the current local capability gaps before planning a higher-risk stage.

### Practice order
- Run the read-only health check first.
- Review research findings and evidence levels.
- Check the watchlist or candidate observations and keep only a few names.
- Review one backtest or validation summary before any simulation idea.
- Move to simulation only after risk budget and readiness checklist are both clear.

### Current assumptions
- candidate_scope: us — Keep the first review universe small and aligned with the preferred market set.
- selection_method: rules_plus_explanation_gate — A symbol can be downgraded when explanation quality, liquidity comfort, or data completeness is not strong enough.
- research_attachment: attached — The candidate framework is stronger when it can reuse the same evidence and risk language as the research artifact.

### Knowledge sections

### Research conclusions
- [mid] The current beginner candidate framework produced 0 watchlist names, 3 observe-only names, and 0 validate-only names.
- [mid] 3 candidate observations still need a single-name research explanation before they should be treated as stage-upgrade candidates.

### Common pitfalls
- Confusing a good story with a tested rule.
- Looking only at return and ignoring drawdown, turnover and sample quality.
- Adding too many correlated names and calling it diversification.
- Letting an LLM summary replace manual review of evidence and risk controls.
- NVDA.US is not yet a beginner_watchlist symbol; keep it in observation or validation mode.
- NVDA.US still lacks a single-name research explanation from local research tooling.

### Minimum viable start
- One market, a small watchlist and a low-frequency review habit.
- A written risk budget with single-position, total-exposure and pause rules.
- At least one backtest or validation note with data-quality and cost assumptions recorded.
- A simulation observation period before any live intent.
- Use the top few beginner_watchlist or observe_only names as the initial review universe.

### Readiness checkpoints
- No readiness checklist has been attached yet.

### What changed from the previous plan
- No previous plan comparison was available for this run.

### Personalization summary
- No explicit personalization summary was recorded for this artifact.

### Update scope
- No scoped profile update information was recorded.

### Next actions
- Keep NVDA.US as an observation name until volatility and execution assumptions are clearer.
- Keep AVGO.US as an observation name until volatility and execution assumptions are clearer.
- Keep MSFT.US as an observation name until volatility and execution assumptions are clearer.
- Fill in single-name explanation notes for the remaining observation names before any stage upgrade discussion.
- Keep the candidate review universe aligned with the preferred markets until the routine is stable.

### Local system boundaries
- Missing local capability: scripts/run_hk_sim_task.py -> Use US-only examples or a manual HK simulation flow until this entry exists.
- Missing local capability: scripts/run_hk_live_task.py -> Do not claim HK live support in automated workflow until the entry exists.
- Missing local capability: scripts/run_hk_futu_sim_session.py -> Use alternative manual HK SIM flow until this entry exists.
- The following local entries require confirmation before execution: scripts/classic_multifactor/run_daily_rebalance.py, scripts/classic_multifactor/run_intraday_loop.py, scripts/classic_multifactor/run_vnpy_cta_backtest.py, scripts/quant_workflow/run_quant_workflow.py, scripts/run_hk_futu_sim_session.py
